leadText: Pikachu's Winter Vacation is a series composed of several Pikachu shorts that are related to winter and Christmas. There are three different sets of segments.
plainText:
Pikachu's Winter Vacation is a series composed of several Pikachu shorts that are related to winter and Christmas. There are three different sets of segments.

==Segments==
Pikachu's Winter Vacation (ピカチュウのふゆやすみ)
Christmas Night / Winter Vacation
Kanga Games / Winter Games

Pikachu's Winter Vacation 2000 or Pokémon Pikachu's Winter Vacation 2 (ピカチュウのふゆやすみ2000)
Winter Games / Winter Vacation 2
Stantler's Little Helpers

Pichu & Pikachu's Winter Vacation 2001 (ピチューとピカチュウのふゆやすみ2001)
Delibird's Dilemma
Snorlax Snowman
Trouble in Big Town

==Release==
 
In Japan, these segments were released on home video as s.

In the United States, the Pikachu's Winter Vacation segments were released as Pokémon Pikachu's Winter Vacation on VHS in 1999; and the Pikachu's Winter Vacation 2000 segments were released as Pokémon Pikachu's Winter Vacation 2 on VHS in 2000. All four of these segments were released in the United States on DVD on November 23, 2004.

In the United Kingdom, the Pikachu's Winter Vacation and Pikachu's Winter Vacation 2000 segments were released together as Pokémon Pikachu's Winter Vacation on VHS in 2001.

The Pikachu's Winter Vacation and Pichu & Pikachu's Winter Vacation 2001 segments were also released as part of Pokémon Chronicles.
The Pikachu's Winter Vacation segments were combined into a single special episode, titled Pikachu's Winter Vacation, and formed episode 22 of Pokémon Chronicles.
Two of the Pichu & Pikachu's Winter Vacation 2001 segments (Delibird's Dilemma and Snorlax Snowman) were combined into a single special episode, also titled Pikachu's Winter Vacation, and formed episode 4 of Pokémon Chronicles.
Trouble in Big Town aired as episode 20 of Pokémon Chronicles.
